scope: P-SQL experiment; one synthetic PM document, retained immutable version roots, stable operation outcomes, provisional recovery generations and tiny in-database attachment blobs. No production backend/encoding accepted.
failure_profile: Real child-process SIGKILL at observed application boundaries on this Linux host; SQLite WAL/FULL/exclusive readback. No OS/power/VFS/macOS/Windows guarantee.
canonical_state: Immutable revision record {doc,attachments} plus one current pointer. Task state only embedded in doc. Blob content addressed; pins and recovery have separate declared metadata roles. No independently writable Markdown/task mirror.
identity: Stable space/document/operation IDs survive restart. Connection bearer token/owner epoch rotate; reconnect before querying the same durable outcome. Retry resolution precedes revision/target resolution.
acknowledgement: Only committed SQL transaction returns applied/durable or protected/durable_recovery. Commit uncertainty/transport loss never becomes an unqualified rejection. Unprotected DOM typing has no durability claim.

cases.title: Exact SQLite profile and single live owner
cases.invariant: Read back WAL/FULL/exclusive/foreign-keys and deny a second owner; a paused owner retains its lock.

cases.title: Desktop, CLI and MCP use one durable owner
cases.invariant: Two browser projections observe the same committed versions as subprocess CLI/MCP; no adapter opens storage.

cases.title: Crash before BEGIN
cases.invariant: Old state and no receipt; same stable identity can apply once after restart.

cases.title: Crash after new revision write
cases.invariant: No orphan revision/outcome/current pointer survives the uncommitted transaction.

cases.title: Crash after outcome write
cases.invariant: State, revision and receipt all roll back, never partial success.

cases.title: Crash before COMMIT with spilled WAL pages
cases.invariant: Uncommitted document/media/receipt changes roll back even with physical WAL frames.

cases.title: Crash after COMMIT before reply
cases.invariant: New state, history and same receipt survive; retry/outcome lookup through fresh connection cannot duplicate.

cases.title: Disconnect and lost reply
cases.invariant: Unknown transport result is not a rejection; MCP outcome and retry resolve the original effect.

cases.title: Uncertain commit return
cases.invariant: Injected lost commit-return status reports uncertain; lookup/restart resolves exact accepted receipt.

cases.title: Revision race and changed duplicate payload
cases.invariant: One guarded revision wins; exact duplicate stable result; reused identity with different payload rejected.

cases.title: Protected provisional draft survives restart
cases.invariant: Draft committed independently remains distinguishable from canonical content and is not auto-restored while live-owned.

cases.title: Newer recovery generations survive stale cleanup
cases.invariant: Old protect/release cannot overwrite or erase latest generation; release tombstone prevents resurrection.

cases.title: Recovery conflict protects work
cases.invariant: Stale-base recovery cannot overwrite newer canonical state; full protected draft remains inspectable.

cases.title: Task properties and pinned revision closure
cases.invariant: Single-document task ID/body/properties stay coherent across crash; pinned historical snapshot remains readable. Does not qualify multi-note task moves.

cases.title: Immutable attachment root closure
cases.invariant: Tiny blob inside same DB transaction and version attachment manifest survive commit/restart; not external file ordering.

cases.title: Missing/damaged canonical closure fails closed
cases.invariant: Missing receipt, altered root/blob or unsupported schema cannot silently initialize/roll back acknowledged state.

cases.title: SQLite allocation-full rollback
cases.invariant: max_page_count allocation failure preserves previous durable roots/outcomes; not physical volume ENOSPC.

cases.title: Lost notification reconciles from revision truth
cases.invariant: Browser clients catch up via authoritative read after a dropped hint; missed event is not lost state.

excluded: No production native-editor integration or durable Y UndoManager serialization.
No multi-document task move/lifecycle qualification, full R03 API, outbox/provider sync, migration/GC/compaction/backups.
No external attachment-file fsync ordering; tiny blobs are inside SQLite only.
Node built-in SQLite is an experiment binding, not desktop language/framework selection.
No current-frame automatic overwrite by recovered text; stale base remains a conflict.
